title: Colorful Polygon
statementMd:
You are given an array $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$, where $n \leq 8$ and $a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n \leq 100$.

Construct a simple polygon$^{\text{∗}}$ with at most $333$ vertices that has exactly $$\frac{(a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n)!}{a_1! a_2! \cdots a_n!}$$ different triangulations$^{\text{†}}$. It can be proven that such a polygon always exists.

$^{\text{∗}}$A [simple polygon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_polygon) is a polygon that does not intersect itself and has no holes. In other words, no two non-consecutive edges can have common points, and consecutive edges must have exactly one common point — the vertex between them. Consecutive edges may be collinear.$^{\text{†}}$A [triangulation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygon_triangulation) of a polygon with $m$ vertices is a set of $m-3$ diagonals that intersect only at vertices. A diagonal is a segment between two vertices which lies inside the polygon and has exactly two common points with the polygon sides — the vertices it connects.

## Input

The first line of each test contains a single integer $n$ ($2 \leq n \leq 8$) — the number of elements in the array.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($1 \leq a_i \leq 100$) — the elements of the array.

It is guaranteed that $a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n$ does not exceed $100$.

## Output

In the first line, output a single integer $m$ ($3 \leq m \leq 333$) — the number of vertices in the polygon.

In the $i$-th of the following $m$ lines, output two integers $x_i$, $y_i$ ($-10^6 \leq x_i, y_i \leq 10^6$) — the coordinates of the $i$-th vertex of the polygon.

The polygon must be simple. The vertices may be given in either clockwise or counterclockwise order.

## Note

In the first test, the required polygon has to have $\tfrac{4!}{1! 1! 2!} = 12$ triangulations. The following are all the triangulations of the example polygon.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fe59c33ade2f25715f361c5aa7968355922a9301.png)

In the second test, the required polygon has to have $\tfrac{5!}{4! 1!} = 5$ triangulations.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bd2c18b43de664f2c00a749db605b45f9bb78131.png)
statementZhMd:
给定一个数组 $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$，其中 $n \leq 8$ 且 $a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n \leq 100$。

构造一个顶点数不超过 $333$ 的简单多边形$^{\text{∗}}$，使其恰好有 $$\frac{(a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n)!}{a_1! a_2! \cdots a_n!}$$ 种不同的三角剖分$^{\text{†}}$。可以证明这样的多边形总是存在。

$^{\text{∗}}$[简单多边形](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_polygon)是指不自交且没有洞的多边形。换句话说，任何两条不相邻的边不能有公共点，而相邻的边必须恰好有一个公共点——即它们之间的顶点。相邻的边可以共线。
$^{\text{†}}$一个有 $m$ 个顶点的多边形的[三角剖分](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygon_triangulation)是指一组仅在顶点处相交的 $m-3$ 条对角线。对角线是连接两个顶点、位于多边形内部的线段，它与多边形的边恰好有两个公共点——即它所连接的两个顶点。

## 输入格式

每个测试的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$2 \leq n \leq 8$）——表示数组中元素的个数。

第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$（$1 \leq a_i \leq 100$）——表示数组的元素。

保证 $a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n$ 不超过 $100$。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数 $m$（$3 \leq m \leq 333$）——表示多边形的顶点数。

接下来的 $m$ 行中，第 $i$ 行输出两个整数 $x_i$, $y_i$（$-10^6 \leq x_i, y_i \leq 10^6$）——表示多边形第 $i$ 个顶点的坐标。

多边形必须是简单多边形。顶点可以按顺时针或逆时针顺序给出。

## 说明

在第一个测试中，所需的多边形必须恰好有 $\tfrac{4!}{1! 1! 2!} = 12$ 种三角剖分。下面是样例多边形的所有三角剖分。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fe59c33ade2f25715f361c5aa7968355922a9301.png)

在第二个测试中，所需的多边形必须恰好有 $\tfrac{5!}{4! 1!} = 5$ 种三角剖分。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bd2c18b43de664f2c00a749db605b45f9bb78131.png)
